description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取大陆场内公募基金的最新份额及资金流向信息。可按基金代码批量查询，返回基金代码、最新数据日期、最新场内收盘价/收盘价涨跌幅、最新场内份额、最新场内资产规模，以及近1/5/20/60/120/240日净流入/流出量及净流入/流出率等数据。当用户想了解某场内公募基金或者对比某些公募基金在不同周期下的份额变动以及净申购赎回金额的统计数据，判断近期资金动向时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain latest share and capital flow information for A-share exchange-traded funds. Supports batch query by fund code, returning fields such as fund code, latest data date, latest exchange-traded closing price/price change, latest exchange-traded shares, latest exchange-traded asset scale, and net inflow/outflow amount and rate for the last 1/5/20/60/120/240 days. Call this interface when users want to understand the latest shares and capital inflow/outflow situation of an exchange-traded fund or assess recent fund flow direction.
